worldcombat.skill.darkestlariat.summary: Strike and push away surrounding enemies, ignoring their stat-stage changes.
worldcombat.skill.darkestlariat.use.0: Spin on the spot and clear everyone around you
worldcombat.skill.darkestlariat.use.1: Ignore the target's raised Defence stages outright
worldcombat.skill.darkestlariat.descript: The full-circle sweep deals about %1$s contact damage within about %2$s blocks; every non-ally inside is settled once, and the target's Defence stages are ignored by this move.
It covers about %1$s blocks vertically; victims are thrown about %2$s blocks outward, the user spins %3$s turns and flings about %4$s gale marks.
worldcombat.skill.darkestlariat.wide.on: Wide spin: radius about %1$s blocks and push about %2$s blocks over a larger circle, but about %3$s damage per target and a longer wind-up and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.darkestlariat.wide.off: Tight spin: radius about %1$s blocks and push about %2$s blocks over a smaller circle, but about %3$s damage per hit and a faster cycle.
worldcombat.skill.darkestlariat.timing: Reach %1$s blocks; %2$s seconds of wind-up, %3$s seconds of recovery, %4$s PP, then a %5$s second cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.darkestlariat.growth.0: At level %1$s the sweep power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.darkestlariat.growth.1: At level %1$s the sweep power rises to %2$s and the radius to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.darkestlariat.preferen: On (wide): radius x1.3, push x1.25 over a larger circle, at the cost of x0.88 per target, +2 ticks of wind-up and +6 of cooldown. Off (tight): a smaller circle but x1.1 per hit and a faster cycle. Each direction has its moment: wide when surrounded, tight when only one target is in reach.
